_comment: Studio's end-stream confirmation dialog. All parts must be spatially related: the heading line, the body or
Cancel line, and the 'End now' button must appear within `max_line_span` consecutive OCR lines (or, when the
OCR backend yields no lines, within `max_char_span` characters). 'End LIVE' or 'End' alone never matches:
the heading AND the confirm button are both required.
Phrases verified 2026-10-09 with Windows OCR on a real dialog crop supplied by the operator (not committed).
Full-window capture of the dialog inside Studio has not been exercised yet.
